build_timing.total_us encloses stages; prepare_snapshot_us and full_staging_us are prepare subcomponents, not additive to total.
phase_timing fields are separately defined/truncated original milliseconds, not a replacement additive wall decomposition.

Project model list/map bodies stay in raw; this projection includes scalar fields and collection lengths only, with exact line/byte/SHA pointers.
Fanout whole_fixture_wall_us covers entire fixture replay including setup/full/oracle. It is not main-stage incremental wall; full build timing unavailable remains absent.
Vectors remain disabled/count:null exactly as emitted; this is no semantic-vector workload.
This script performs derived data consistency checks, not original semantic validation or a new acceptance gate. Original outputs were already accepted.
